verdictHolds.reason: The cluster's own 16 files (all sixteen files 322f8b01 and the six plants commits touched) are confirmed complete against `git show --stat` on each commit, and every one is either genuinely untouched by the branch or touched on exactly the single non-overlapping `const view` line claimed — confirmed by diffing the branch against each repo's merge base directly (not just reading the trial-merge tree). The 'clean, no manual resolution needed' verdict for this cluster's own files holds. The three misattributions found are in `journeyConflictAttribution`'s descriptive notes about OTHER clusters' files (auth-convergence vs EUDPA-619 test scaffolding) — they do not touch any file this cluster's own verdict depends on, so they do not change the verdict, only the accuracy of the reference notes.

countriesLoadingFinding: On plants MAIN at the merge base (77a5aa7, which is itself PR #71's merge commit landing EUDPA-575 for plants) countries already load lazily on first read via ensureLoaded()/originCountries(); on animals MAIN at its merge base (226fc703, downstream of EUDPA-575's fb3615e3) countries already load lazily on first read too — both predate the alignment branch and the branch changes neither (empty diff on services/countries and services/ports for both repos, merge base to branch). Only ins loaded reference data at boot before the alignment; s19-countries-lazy-load is the one stage that changes this, and it is scoped to ins only. So 'countries load on first read rather than at boot in ins and plants' from the programme brief is true only as a description of the post-alignment end state across all three frontends — it is not something the branch ships FOR plants (plants already had it, unmodified, since before the fork); it is a genuine behaviour change the branch ships for ins alone.
